q.noticedWhen: How long since you noticed it?

touch.card1: Mirror check: arms down, hands on hips, arms up.
touch.card2: Lie down. Use 3 fingers, small circles, light then firm pressure.
touch.card3: Check whole breast, armpit, and collarbone.
touch.card4: Standing or in the shower, repeat the same circles.
touch.card5: Gently squeeze the nipple. Look for any discharge.

result.safetyLine: Most lumps are not cancer, but every new lump needs checking.
result.green: No warning signs found. Stay breast-aware and get a clinical breast exam from age 30.
result.yellow: Please see a doctor or breast clinic within 2 weeks.
result.red: Please see a doctor within a few days.
result.title: Your Result
result.disclaimer: Only a doctor can confirm this.

reason.redUrgent: Fever with a red, hot, swollen breast.
reason.sizeChange: Change in breast size or shape.
reason.feltLump: Felt a lump or skin change.
